run_bvh_visualizer_single: run the BVH visualizer to play back a single motion capture file in an interactive GLUT window
run_bvh_visualizer_multi: run the BVH visualizer to display multiple motion capture files side by side with x-offset spacing
run_asfamc_visualizer: run the visualizer to play back ASF/AMC motion capture files using the asf-files and amc-files arguments
review_MocapViewer_keyboard_callback: review the MocapViewer keyboard_callback method that handles frame stepping, speed control, and screenshot recording
review_MocapViewer_render_pose: review the MocapViewer _render_pose method that renders skeleton joints as points and capsules in OpenGL
